shortDescription: SpiceJet BSE:SPICEJET will raise funds worth 55 billion rupees ($588.6 million), the company said on Wednesday, as the cash-strapped Indian carrier seeks to strengthen its finances after prolonged operational and regulatory challenges.($1 = 93.4350 Indian rupees)
